input.body:
label: feature
file: src/export/

Thanks for the request. Report export currently supports CSV and XLSX (see src/export/, which houses the CSV and XLSX writers), but there's no tab-delimited (TSV) option yet. Adding a TSV writer alongside the existing CSV/XLSX writers in src/export/ would let the warehouse loader consume exports directly, without the manual comma-escaping workaround. Marking this as a feature request.

input.title: Add TSV export option alongside CSV and XLSX
input.body: File: src/export/. Add a tab-delimited (TSV) export format next to the existing CSV and XLSX writers, so report exports can be written with tab separators for warehouse loaders that only accept tab-delimited files, avoiding the current manual comma-to-tab conversion issues.
